The through line

Good software is a team sport - and the details matter.

I work across the seams between product design, web engineering and native mobile. That means reusable interfaces, clear platform boundaries and the testing and release work that helps a product stay reliable after it ships.

More recently, I’ve built project-aware AI workflows that give development tools useful context while keeping review and release decisions with people.

04 / DEVELOPER SECURITY

A pre-push check that keeps personal data out of Git. (hushpush on GitHub)

A local, offline Rust CLI that finds personal data such as emails and card numbers in screenshots and logs before they reach a Git remote. OCR runs on PP-OCRv5, output is masked, and it fails closed.

  • Rust
  • OCR
  • Git hooks
  • PII detection

Open source toolhushpush ↗
